summary: This note describes Saloum Delta National Park, known in French as Parc National du Delta du Saloum, a national park in Senegal. It was established in 1976 and lies within the Saloum Delta where the Saloum River meets the North Atlantic. The note is brief and gives no further details.
one_line: Saloum Delta National Park is a Senegalese national park, established in 1976, located where the Saloum River meets the North Atlantic.
key_facts: Saloum Delta National Park is also called Parc National du Delta du Saloum in French.
Saloum Delta National Park is located in Senegal.
Saloum Delta National Park is a national park.
Saloum Delta National Park was established in 1976.
Saloum Delta National Park is situated within the Saloum Delta.
Saloum Delta National Park sits at the juncture of the Saloum River and the North Atlantic.
